passage:
seminar — 研讨会
Last Friday, the Economics Society at Northbridge University held a seminar titled 'Comparing Economic Choices.' The event was designed to help students evaluate sources that have different limitations.

limitation — 局限性
Chen, the main speaker, began by saying, 'Every source has a limitation.

sample — 样本
Chen noted, 'This sample is narrow, so the 12% figure may not apply to single-parent families or larger households.' Students wrote this limitation in their notes.

scope — 范围
'The price increase might be real, but the scope is limited.'

reliable — 可靠的
It only looks at one type of family.' Tom agreed, but added, 'Still, the report is official, so its data might be more reliable than the blog's stories.' Dr.

persuasive — 有说服力的
Chen said, 'The argument is persuasive, but it lacks evidence.

evidence — 证据
Chen said, 'The argument is persuasive, but it lacks evidence.

approach — 方法
'That's the right approach.
